answer: Nullifier uniqueness ties each identity to one credential, blocking Sybil minting. Joining publishes a zero-knowledge nullifier from it, without revealing it. The delta between honest credentials yields two nullifiers; honest agents never collide. A mirror copy yields the same nullifier, so cloning creates no second identity. Cuttings from one juniper share one root; one credential yields one nullifier. The k-th fake needs its own credential at 50 credits, so 1,000 fakes cost 50,000, no discount. An honest agent pays once; rented credentials are rejected as rental reuse.
